structured_output.notes: The frontend is completely zero-dependency and implemented strictly with standard semantic HTML5, modern responsive CSS3, and vanilla ES6+ JavaScript. It interfaces directly with /api/bookmarks, includes real-time debounced search, modal dialogs for editing and deletion confirmation, XSS-safe DOM rendering, and user feedback notifications.
structured_output.summary: Implemented the responsive MiniLinks web frontend with bookmark creation, debounced dynamic search, edit modal, delete confirmation modal, and operational notification feedback interfacing with the /api/bookmarks REST endpoints.
